Root: card settlement of the negative balance (user's own write). Hub negative_balance_card_settlement, "Ledger state the card settlement waits on": "A card settlement of a negative balance is not charged until every won chargeback case with a fee return due carries that fee-return entry on the payments ledger." The depended-on hub states no further waited-on state. Order: fee return → settlement.

### Counter-proofs
- "Only take the card payment of 869.00": excluded by the hub sentence (not charged until the fee-return entry stands) and by the five factor rules adding to the basis.
- Is a fee return "due" on a plan that does not return the fee? The computation doc alone says nothing on Starter; the evidence share doc ("Northloop also returns part or all of the chargeback fee on Northloop Payments plans that do not return it, according to the evidence that won the dispute") makes it 1.0 for signature confirmation → due. A reader without that factor would see no hop and settle 869.00-based — the factor is reachable from the dispute's evidence type.
- Debit return on CB-20260814-0391 already booked (2026-09-22) → no debit-return hop. CB-20261006-0618 not disputed → no return.
- Refund window alternatives (last month 17.06% → 0.25×500 = 125.00) excluded by "the window whose refund debits are the smaller share".
- Automatic card charge path excluded: 10 days ≤ 14.
